Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - C.C. No. 2928/2020

Dear Ms. Nambiar,

Thank you for meeting us on 21 October 2020 about your dispute with Pillai Constructions. As we understand it, the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate. The matter is listed before the Mysuru District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

Our advice is to seek a full refund with interest because the builder failed to obtain the occupancy certificate. Please collect the builder-buyer agreement, payment receipts and the municipal reply on the occupancy certificate and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
